summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long TEL Daily ETF (TELG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of TE Connectivity plc (TICKER: TEL) stock, less fees and expenses. TEL engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. TELG was launched on Jun 16, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
